slides.title: Ballon d'Or night, taken apart.
slides.sub: What two clubs posted, and what stood out.

slides.title: 781.6k likes on the Kane graphic
slides.body: Its biggest post, a reel, reached 2.2M likes.
slides.tip: Hypothesis: the bio change gave fans one more reason to engage.

slides.title: 980.9k likes on Yamal's trophy
slides.body: Barça's biggest gala post was a carousel, not the award photo.

slides.title: 546k likes on a ranking list
slides.body: Top comments asked “Where's CR7?” and “Where is the points?”
slides.tip: Hypothesis: a list invites debate about who is missing.

slides.title: 9+ posts vs 8+, reels and feed
slides.body: Bayern posted 9+ Kane or gala posts, Barça 8+, as visible on each grid. Bayern's top was a reel (2.2M likes); Barça's, a feed carousel (1.9M). Reach is unknown.
slides.tip: Plan a full gala-night grid, not one post.

slides.title: The club commented first
slides.body: Under the winner graphic, Bayern's own comment “Just updated our bio 😏” got 2.2k likes and 32 replies.
slides.tip: Hypothesis: a small inside joke gives fans something to reply to.

slides.title: Turn the trophy into a bio, a grid and a reel. Bayern did all three the same night.
Mix the headline graphic with the human moments: arrival, couples, the award.
